description: This file defines the HomeListenerService class which extends WearableListenerService. It listens to DataItem events (additions, deletions) on the wearable device. When data changes are detected, it cancels notifications or posts new notifications related to geofence triggers using Android's Notification API. The class utilizes GoogleApiClient for Google Play services and manages notifications for geofence IDs, mainly for Android Wear OS devices.

classes.name: HomeListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for data events from wearable devices to manage geofence-related notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects it when the service is created.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events; cancels notifications on deletion or posts notifications when geofence data changes.

methods.name: cancelNotificationForDataItem
methods.description: Cancels existing notifications related to a DataItem.

methods.name: postNotificationForGeofenceId
methods.description: Creates and posts a notification based on the geofence ID and associated data.
